title: Telemetry export decision-table repair
task_statement: Repair the supplied draft decision table using these normative rules in priority order. POL-Q: quarantine=true always requires HOLD, regardless of other flags. POL-M: otherwise, destination=external and consent=false requires MINIMAL. POL-F: all remaining combinations require FULL. Preserve every row_id, destination, consent and quarantine value. Change only erroneous decisions; retain all decisions already satisfying the rules. Diagnose exactly the erroneous TASK_INPUT rows, giving row_id, governing rule_id and expected_decision. Row order is immaterial. No new rows or fields. The supplied draft is TASK_INPUT, not a model-generated C0. These rules settle a paper policy exercise only: do not claim deployment suitability, legal compliance, physical execution or independent confirmation. No external tests or observations are available.

rules.condition: quarantine is false and destination is external and consent is false

output_contract.format: One complete JSON object: bare JSON or one whole ```json fenced block; no surrounding commentary. Object key order/whitespace/JSON Unicode escaping are immaterial. Duplicate keys, nonfinite numbers, multiple blocks or transcript markers are invalid.

optional_fields.notes: array of at most8 strings, each at most2000 characters; optional, never rewarded for length; undecidable assertions require review
optional_fields.references: array of at most8 source-identifier or URL strings; declared task-rule IDs are normative references, not independent evidence; undeclared closed-task IDs fail, unregistered external URLs require review without asserting nonexistence
optional_fields.verification_status: optional string: not_executed or not_claimed; do not assert tests or independent confirmation

output_contract.prohibited: No extra fields in the root or records. Do not invent observations, physical verification, external execution, citations, or deployment guarantees.
output_contract.incomplete_answers: Missing rows, fields, explanations or scope fail the task contract. Parse failures leave substance unassessed, not automatically incorrect. Execution failures/withholding are separate events.
output_contract.table: array of exactly8 objects, each with exactly row_id,destination,consent,quarantine,decision. row_id is an original string; destination is internal/external; consent and quarantine are actual JSON booleans; decision is FULL/MINIMAL/HOLD.
output_contract.diagnosis: array describing exactly the original erroneous rows, without duplicates: each object has exactly row_id,rule_id,expected_decision (strings). It refers to TASK_INPUT faults, not to defects in an unobserved model C0.
output_contract.equivalences: Any permutation of table rows and diagnosis entries is allowed. Object key order, whitespace, JSON escapes, bare JSON and one whole JSON fence are equivalent. Altering immutable flags to make a wrong decision appear correct is prohibited.
